coordinate_frame: animal rest/glide; abs(x) on mirrored half, y up, z forward; metres

nape.condition: abs(x) < 0.035 under the head, broadening to 0.040 half-width at z=0.29 and 0.045 at z=0.20; behind centreline_yz_m, with signed perpendicular depth used for the back gate
nape.join: actual shared neck/head top ring in live position bake; rear midline about (0, 1.351, 0.401) m; use body.paint.mantle_distance and mantle_ids or nearest live body texels at the shared cut
nape.surface: live fuzz study, face scale near the head; no baked form shading
nape.fringe: live round 4 mantle_edge categorical drawing; unchanged on mantle, half the across-edge span at y >= 1.32 m to match face-scale pile (smooth from y=1.14 m); roughly 1 to 2 cm interleaving under head

profile.measurement: perpendicular YZ distance inward from the rear silhouette, located in live neck position/normal maps (abs(normal.x) < 0.04, normal.z < -0.2); stations run by silhouette arc length from head to mantle
profile.edge: same live mantle_edge drawing and face-scale transition; convert projected inset to local surface distance for the interlocking fringe
profile.scope: union with accepted dorsal stripe on neck only; torso mantle and all material maps retained
profile.head_contract: full_width_m retains the accepted 70 mm minimum at the shared cut; profile inset controls the added side coverage

body_to_leg: same animal-space fuzz field across both pieces; no independent UV phase
arm_to_small_hands: region 2 horn skin; hand study scale 0.70; no base shadow at knuckle
saddle: unpressed natural fuzz; no saddle contact shading in these maps
